key.name: password-prompt-monitor
key.description: Connector name (for example HDMI-2 or DP-1) of the monitor where GNOME Shell's password prompts open: polkit, keyring unlock, Wi-Fi/VPN secrets and encrypted disk unlock. Empty, or a monitor that is not connected: they open under the pointer as usual.

key.name: password-prompt-dim
key.description: GNOME Shell darkens all monitors behind its password prompts. False: the prompt opens without the overlay, so the other monitors stay as they are. The prompt still takes the keyboard until it is answered or cancelled.
